company.name: Dash0
company.shortDescription: Dash0 is an OpenTelemetry-native observability platform for collecting, transmitting, and analyzing distributed system data.
company.description: Dash0 is an observability platform that enables engineering teams to monitor, analyze, and manage application performance and system behavior. The platform collects and processes telemetry data such as logs, metrics, and traces, allowing users to investigate issues and understand system interactions. It offers tools for visualizing distributed systems, helping teams identify bottlenecks and troubleshoot incidents. Dash0 integrates with existing infrastructure and supports open standards to streamline data ingestion and analysis. Its features assist teams in maintaining system reliability and improving operational workflows through data-driven insights.
